en.headline: Sightseeing boat sinks off Hung Hom new waterfront; no one trapped
en.dek: Firefighters and divers searched the vessel after a report of it taking on water around 2pm; the boat had been moored for more than a month.
body: A sightseeing boat partially sank in waters off the Hung Hom new waterfront near Cheong Wan Road on Saturday afternoon. Fire services and police responded after a passer-by reported the vessel taking on water around 2pm.
Divers searched the boat and confirmed no one was trapped or injured. The vessel was found listing heavily to starboard with part of its hull submerged.
Authorities later contacted the owner, who said the boat had been moored at the location for more than a month. The cause of the sinking remains under investigation.

zh.headline: 紅磡新海濱觀光船入水下沉 消防證實無人被困
zh.dek: 下午近2時有途人報稱船隻入水，消防派出蛙人搜索後確認無人受傷或受困，船隻已停泊逾一個月。
body: 周六下午近2時，一艘停泊在紅磡暢運道新海濱對開海面的觀光船據報入水下沉。途人報警後，警方及消防趕至現場。
消防派出蛙人落水搜索，其後證實船內無人被困，亦無人受傷。現場所見，船隻嚴重向右傾側，部分船身浸在水中。
當局其後成功聯絡船主，得悉該船已在該處停泊超過一個月。沉沒原因有待調查。
